en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street corner with a multi‑story building on the left bearing the word "Sparkasse" (savings bank). In front of the building are a few people standing by an arched entrance. On the right is a small memorial area with two artillery pieces (cannons) flanking a stone monument topped with a sphere and bordered by cannonballs. Mature trees stand behind the monument. In the lower right corner is a printed photographer's credit and location.
